patch_description: Inspired by the prior programs' multi-seed construction, best-improvement move/swap refine, and ILS with safe rollback, this version adds a targeted "hottest-GPU destroy" perturbation: pick the current bottleneck GPU with high probability, relocate its highest req_rate/slo model to the best-fitting destination by post-move KVPR (not randomly), plus one random relocation elsewhere, then repair with refine+swap_refine and keep only improvements. This directly attacks the max-KVPR bottleneck instead of wasting rounds on random kicks.
